properties.name: max.bot.token
properties.description: Bot access token. The auto-configuration is active only when it is set; a blank token turns the bot off with a warning.

properties.name: max.bot.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the API; override it only for tests or proxies.

properties.name: max.bot.trust-russian-root-ca
properties.description: Whether the client trusts the Russian Trusted Root CA, which the API server's certificate is issued under and which JDKs do not include.

properties.name: max.bot.rate-limit
properties.description: Client-side rate limit: max (default), the limits of Max (30 requests per second, 2 answers to button presses per second in a chat), or none.

properties.name: max.bot.startup-timeout
properties.description: How long startup waits for the API before it goes on and retries in the background.

properties.name: max.bot.proxy
properties.description: Proxy for the requests to the API: http://host:port, http://user:password@host:port or socks://host:port (credentials only for http).

properties.name: max.bot.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long the client waits to connect to the API.

properties.name: max.bot.read-timeout
properties.description: How long the client waits for data from the API, besides long polling.

properties.name: max.bot.parallelism
properties.description: Most handlers running at once; updates of a chat are handled one at a time and in order.

properties.name: max.bot.queue-capacity
properties.description: Most updates waiting in the queue of one chat; further ones are dropped (polling) or refused with 503 (webhook).

properties.name: max.bot.handler-timeout
properties.description: Longest time a handler may run before it is cancelled; 0 for no limit.

properties.name: max.bot.poll-timeout
properties.description: How long one long polling request waits for updates, up to 90 seconds.

properties.name: max.bot.auto-answer-callbacks
properties.description: Whether the bot answers button presses its handlers left unanswered, so that the client of the user stops showing them as loading.

properties.name: max.bot.shutdown-timeout
properties.description: How long stopping the lifecycle directly waits for the updates already received; a context shutdown uses spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase.

properties.name: max.bot.mode
properties.description: How the bot receives updates: polling, webhook or none.

properties.name: max.bot.sync-commands
properties.description: Whether to show the commands registered with descriptions in the bot menu on startup.

properties.name: max.bot.webhook.path
properties.description: Path of the webhook endpoint.

properties.name: max.bot.webhook.url
properties.description: Public HTTPS URL of the endpoint; when set, the bot subscribes to it on startup.

properties.name: max.bot.webhook.secret
properties.description: Secret Max sends in the X-Max-Bot-Api-Secret header; requests with another value get 401. By default a secret derived from the token.

properties.name: max.bot.webhook.async
properties.description: Answer 200 right after parsing the update and run the handler in the background.

properties.name: max.bot.webhook.check-interval
properties.description: How often to check that the subscription to max.bot.webhook.url still exists and to subscribe again if Max dropped it; 0 turns the check off.

properties.name: max.bot.webhook.max-body-size
properties.description: Largest request body the webhook endpoint reads; larger requests get 413.

properties.name: max.bot.storage
properties.description: Where dialog states, the polling marker and the keys of seen updates are kept: memory, jdbc (needs maxapi-jdbc) or redis (needs maxapi-redis); without the module the application fails to start.

properties.name: max.bot.jdbc.table-prefix
properties.description: Prefix of the table names: <prefix>dialog_state, <prefix>bot_marker and <prefix>seen_update.

properties.name: max.bot.jdbc.create-tables
properties.description: Whether to create missing tables on startup; turn it off when migrations create them.

properties.name: max.bot.redis.url
properties.description: Redis URI, e.g. redis://:password@host:6379/0.

properties.name: max.bot.redis.key-prefix
properties.description: Prefix of the keys: <prefix>state:..., <prefix>marker and <prefix>seen:....

properties.name: max.bot.redis.state-ttl
properties.description: How long a dialog state is kept after its last change; by default until it is cleared.

properties.name: max.bot.web-app.source
properties.description: Where a mini app sends window.WebApp.initData for @MaxWebAppUser parameters: header, parameter (query or form) or body (then the method cannot have a @RequestBody parameter).

properties.name: max.bot.web-app.header
properties.description: Header with initData when max.bot.web-app.source is header.

properties.name: max.bot.web-app.parameter
properties.description: Query or form parameter with initData when max.bot.web-app.source is parameter; a query parameter ends up in access logs.

properties.name: max.bot.web-app.max-age
properties.description: How old the auth_date of initData may be; older data is answered with 401.

properties.name: max.bot.health.cache-ttl
properties.description: How long the health indicator reuses the result of its request to the API, so that frequent health checks do not use up the request limit; 0 asks on every check.

properties.name: max.bot.health.timeout
properties.description: How long a health check waits for the API and the storage before reporting them down.
